description: Get one investing person by id: investing role, roles and firm history, companies, their own investments, and every contact route they published (email, LinkedIn, X, personal site), each with the page it was published on, the quoted text showing it, and whether it is a personal or a role address. Phone numbers and home addresses are never collected. People and their contact routes come from public sources — the firm's own site or the person's own published page. Anyone can request removal at support@pipeworx.io.
